title: sanitize_display strips only SGR sequences not other ANSI escapes
description: app.rs sanitize_display only strips ESC+[ sequences ending in 'm' (SGR). Other ANSI escape sequences — OSC (ESC+]), DCS, APC, cursor positioning (ESC+[A-Z not m) — are not stripped. A message body containing ESC[2J (clear screen) or ESC[5;5H (cursor position) would pass through and corrupt the terminal display since ratatui renders strings via crossterm which handles raw bytes. Trigger: peer sends a message containing a terminal escape sequence that is not an SGR color code.
